reasoning_content: Check the examples directory to figure out which HTML page to copy, and verify the referenced files. Also check what's being used in index.html and the other top-level HTML pages (e.g., is index.html referencing baseConfig_noProxy.json?).

action.command: grep -o 'config/[^"]*' /workspace/*.html /workspace/examples/*/*.html 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | head -40; echo ====; ls -R /workspace/examples | head -80
